identity.description: Devin is an autonomous AI software engineer built by Cognition (an applied AI lab). Its docs are at docs.devin.ai and its web app at app.devin.ai. The assignment hint pointed at docs.devin.ai, which is the correct vendor site.
identity.identity_notes: docs.devin.ai describes Devin as an AI software engineer from Cognition. Not Devin Technologies or other unrelated 'Devin' products. Confirmed via the docs homepage quote and Cognition's own pricing blog.

auth.token_refresh: No refresh flow. Service user keys default to 30-day expiry (7 days, 90 days, or Never where allowed). Rotation is manual: generate new keys and revoke old ones; enterprises can rotate via API (beta).
auth.scopes_notes: Service users are role-based bot accounts (Admin role gives full org access; Admin is required for impersonation via ImpersonateOrgSessions). Scope is determined by the service user's role, not per-key OAuth scopes. No OAuth flow documented on the authentication page.

access.production_restrictions: No app review was found in the sources. Enterprise API scope (cross-org management) is for enterprise customers with RBAC, per the docs. Free plan exists but official sources do not state whether it includes API access. A third-party guide claims Devin API is paid-only (unverified). Official blog gives a 2-week trial for Devin Review only, not for the API.

read_ops: Session listing (organization users list endpoints also referenced, details unverified)
api.rate_limits: Not specified in fetched docs; only a 429 'Rate limit exceeded' status is documented.
api.limitations: Only partial endpoint list verified. Organization API covers sessions, knowledge, playbooks, secrets and more. Enterprise API covers analytics, audit logs, user management, billing, infrastructure. Read vs write split per resource not verified beyond session creation. Rate limit documented only as 429 response.
